body.t: Query the Census coordinate geography service for congressional-district context at a US point. Keep the coordinate and source vintage with the returned identifier. Redistricting can change the correct answer even when the address itself has not moved. Record the input and mode with any exported or reported result.

Compare two nearby coordinates on opposite sides of a known district boundary. The lookup may return different identifiers; confirm the effective election map with the relevant election authority rather than assuming a current address label proves a district.
